description: Invite a staff/team member to a live event by email with a role — host (Producer), manager, guest_list, door_person, or promoter (Co-Host). Sends an invite email; they join on accept. Requires a Pro plan. Manage existing staff with list_event_staff / update_staff_role / demote_staff_to_guest. Requires event_id + email + role; you must be a host.
name: invite_team_member
title: Invite Team Member
